TestCompressionChunkSize::test_sstable_c.description: Single node; parametrized over Deflate/LZ4/Snappy. CREATE TABLE with chunk_length_in_kb=256 must fail ('Query invalid because of configuration issue'), CREATE with 128 succeeds and driver schema metadata shows class + chunk 128; ALTER to 256 fails, ALTER to 64 succeeds and metadata shows 64. Guards the 128 KB max chunk length added in scylla 8a9de08510 (issue scylladb/scylladb#9933).

origin.summary: QA task (scylladb/qa-tasks#1400): positive/negative tests for 128KB chunk size cap.

commits.2fc5f638f1f7bb347add33795ff2b4b4f3b3c986: file-level: TestHelper base class copied from removed scrub_test.py (copied without its imports; test uses none of its helpers)

TestCompressionChunkSize::test_sstable_c.relevance: Live: sstables/compressor.cc validate() rejects chunk_length > 128*1024 ('chunk_length_in_kb/chunk_length_kb must be 128 or less.'); check is compressor-independent, so the 3 params exercise the same code path.

duplicates.note: CREATE and ALTER with chunk_length_in_kb over max rejected with ConfigurationException (LZ4; value 1048576 vs dtest's 256, same `> 128*1024` check).
CREATE LZ4 chunk 128 accepted, ALTER Deflate chunk 64 accepted, options read back.
CREATE with Snappy/LZ4/Deflate + chunk_length_in_kb, schema options read back.
ALTER compression class + chunk_length_in_kb, schema read back.
256 KB rejected via yaml/cmdline default table options (same validator).

TestCompressionChunkSize::test_sstable_c.reason: Pure CQL schema-validation test, fully covered by scylla tests: test/cqlpy/test_sstable_compression.py::test_huge_chunk_length (CREATE+ALTER over-max rejected), boost sstable_compression_config_test (128/64 accepted + readback), cqlpy create_test/alter_test (all 3 compressors with chunk_length_in_kb). No cluster/dtest-specific aspect. Note: class TestHelper (compression_test.py:6-170, copied in 2fc5f638f) references undefined os/glob/re/shutil/tempfile/logger/common/KEYSPACE — dead code that would NameError if called; unused by this test.
